base_reach_protocol.target: right blue marker x from the shared GT initial frame
base_reach_protocol.level_scan: ascending numerical levels; first predicted reaching level, without consulting GT
base_reach_protocol.gt_selection: same ascending scan and threshold applied independently to GT
base_reach_protocol.offscreen: reuse confirmed-exit last-visible position; never assume a new offscreen position
base_reach_protocol.coordinate_system: native crop pixels; the original camera x-offset cancels in the comparison
base_reach_protocol.no_reach: None; no fallback to highest level
base_reach_protocol.missing_measurement: explicitly unscorable; never silently ignore a lower unknown level
base_reach_protocol.aggregation: equal weight per environment; reachable-GT accuracy and correct abstention reported separately

action_selection.no_reach: empty pair, score zero; never substitute highest level
action_selection.maximum_level_policy: For first level 10, retain the formal pair [10, 11] exactly as requested. Level 11 is an extrapolated label, not an observed or evaluated rollout. Never clip or duplicate the last level.
action_selection.successor_reach_check: Not required: successor is added arithmetically, not tested for reach.

frame_policy: Recorded evaluation_frame_indices; exclude conditioning frame and repeated tail padding
image_geometry: Exclude letterbox bars; compare corresponding content crops
object_geometry: Inverse-letterboxed native image pixels; Door uses tracked door edge, not a physical angle
ball_exit_policy: Retain last-visible position only after confirmed right-side exit
aggregation: Report train and test separately; scoreboard uses test environment macro means
fairness_note: Ours Stage2 uses the existing customized supports and initializations, including near-environment-table starts. This is not an equal-information or equal-training-step benchmark.
